_about: Default role-count targets (Bracket 2-3 midrange) and strategy/bracket offsets. Counts are weighted (a card filling two roles counts in both). Sources: Command Zone Ep. 658 'Commander Deckbuilding Template for the New Era' (Feb 18 2025): ramp 10, card advantage 12, targeted disruption 12, mass disruption 6, lands 38, plan 30; Kraken the Meta and Spellweave 2026 guides (removal 8-10, wipes 2-4, win cons 2-4); Karsten land formula. Strategy offsets are a synthesis of common practice, not a single primary source.

voltron._note: Cheap equipment/auras count as plan; symmetrical wipes hurt you more than opponents.

spellslinger._note: Cantrips push the land count down; cheap interaction doubles as plan.

tokens._note: Flag symmetrical wipes. Anthems/overrun effects are the win conditions.

aristocrats._note: Sac outlets and death-trigger payoffs are engine; edicts double as interaction.

stax._note: Stax pieces count as mass disruption; mass land denial pushes the deck to Bracket 4+.

combo._note: Fast mana lowers the land count; protect the combo.

polymorph._note: Polymorph/cheat decks win with whatever the library hands them, so fewer dedicated win conditions are needed in hand; expect lots of engine (polymorph effects) and fodder (repeatable tokens) and tolerate a high 7+ count, since big hits are cheated in rather than cast. Report hit density for every reveal-until effect.

cheat._note: Alias of polymorph: cheat-into-play decks (sneak, reveal-until, reanimation).

reanimator._note: Reanimation targets are cheated in; expect self-mill/discard enablers as engine and a high 7+ count.

1._note: Exhibition: theme over power. Report deviations gently; targets are loose.

4._note: Optimized: lower curve, more fast mana and tutors.

5._note: cEDH: generic targets fit poorly; judge against the competitive meta instead.
